plan.title: Award Vendor A and Approve Proposal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the two bids directly on Master QCS.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor A, the non-lowest bidder.
Verify one line is selected, exactly one of two vendors is awarded, and Vendor A's proposal value is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create the proposal from the completed allocation.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the award proposal for approval.
Verify the submitted proposal is awaiting approval.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver, open the proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: A separate approver login is required and cannot be performed by the buyer session.
After approval, complete the award workflow and create the purchase order.
Verify one PO contains the awarded line with quantity 10.
